title: Result dataset title
rangeHelp: Select a contiguous range in the original source-row order. Every selected sample must be present and included. No samples are removed, padded or reordered.
origin: Coordinate of the first selected sample
coordinateCheck: Validate a coordinate column against this exact grid
samplingHelp: The origin denotes the first selected sample. The transform phase uses selected sample index 0; the origin does not add a phase shift. A coordinate column, when selected, must equal origin + index times step after exact unit conversion.
conventions: Forward unscaled transform; rectangular window; no detrending; full unshifted bins. A single sample has only bin 0. For N > 1, signed bins are 0 through N/2 - 1, then -N/2 through -1; Nyquist is negative.
magnitudeHelp: Normalized squared magnitude is |X|²/N². It is not watts or a power spectral density. N is the selected sample count; no window-gain correction is applied.
coefficientHelp: The native complex coefficient keeps real and imaginary components in that order. Inspect either component or extract it explicitly for plotting.
precisionHelp: Exact arithmetic remains exact where admitted. Other trigonometric values use the saved engine 4 precision, rounding and library. Display digits do not truncate retained values.
busy: Spectral operation in progress. Please wait.
invalid: Choose a supported scalar or native complex signal, an explicit power-of-two range, a sampling difference unit and a valid saved calculation policy. Tapered windows require at least two samples. Your entries are retained.
previewNote: The complete selected range is transformed. This preview shows at most five output frequencies; retain the result to read and export every output.
previewTruncated: A preview scalar is shortened. The retained result preserves its complete computational value.
approximate: Approximate transform value under the saved calculation policy
publicRole-frequency: frequency in the inverse declared sampling unit
publicRole-normalized-squared-magnitude: normalized squared magnitude |X|²/N², not watts or PSD
publicConventions: Rectangular window; no detrend; forward unscaled; full unshifted order with negative Nyquist for N > 1. Phase begins at selected sample index 0.
publicChecked: The declared coordinate grid was checked.
publicUnchecked: Sampling was explicitly declared without a coordinate-column check.
savedHelp: Earlier results retain their source revision and sampling declaration. Reapplying creates a result revision and preserves this result.
noInputs: No selected samples on this page.
repeatFromDataset: Open the retained result dataset to reapply its pinned spectral recipe.
publicRole-coefficient-real: explicitly extracted real component of the complex coefficient
publicRole-coefficient-imaginary: explicitly extracted imaginary component of the complex coefficient
executionUpgrade: Upgrade to explicit numerical job limits
executionLegacy: This saved recipe uses version 1 numerical resource accounting. Keep that interpretation, or explicitly upgrade this draft to version 2. Earlier results keep their saved recipe.
executionCalculationBounds: Each slice must also fit the maximum operations and milliseconds in the saved calculation policy.
executionCalculationInvalid: The numerical slice exceeds the saved calculation policy. Adjust its maximum operations or active milliseconds, or explicitly revise that calculation policy. Your entries are retained.
method-radix2-fft-v1: Radix-2 FFT on a declared uniform grid
method-direct-coordinate-fourier-v1: Direct Fourier sum at declared coordinates
windowHelp: Periodic windows use the original selected row ordinal n/N, even when coordinates are irregular or pairs are omitted. Positions are never compacted. A taper requires at least two selected samples. No window-gain correction is applied.
directSamplingHelp: Each selected scalar coordinate is used in its original row order, including repeated or nonmonotonic coordinates. Origin is the explicit phase reference. No uniform sampling, sorting, interpolation or clock meaning is inferred.
frequencyHelp: Output position j uses start + j times step, in this declared frequency unit. The output count is independent of the selected sample count. No Nyquist wrapping or relabeling is applied.
fftConventions: Forward unscaled transform; no detrending; full unshifted bins. A single sample has only bin 0. For N > 1, signed bins are 0 through N/2 - 1, then -N/2 through -1; Nyquist is negative.
directConventions: Forward unscaled direct Fourier sum over explicit coordinates; no detrending; results follow the authored frequency grid.
methodUpgrade: Enable explicit windows and coordinate Fourier sums
methodLegacy: This saved recipe keeps its original method, rectangular window and numerical accounting. Explicitly upgrade this draft to version 3 to choose windows or a direct coordinate transform; earlier results keep their saved interpretation.
invalidDirect: Choose a scalar or native complex signal, a positive sample count, a distinct scalar coordinate column, explicit coordinate and frequency difference units, a positive frequency count and a valid saved calculation policy. Tapered windows require at least two samples. Your entries are retained.
publicDirectContext: {method}; {role}; {count} selected samples; {outputCount} output frequencies. {conventions} Origin {origin}. {coordinate} {unit} Frequency start {frequencyStart}; step {frequencyStep}; {frequencyUnit} {precision}
publicDirectCoordinates: Explicit source coordinates are used in retained row order, including repeats and nonmonotonic order; no uniform sampling is claimed.
publicDirectConventions: {window}; no detrend; forward unscaled; authored frequency-grid order. The declared origin is the phase reference. No Nyquist relabeling or window-gain correction.
publicFftConventions: {window}; no detrend; forward unscaled; full unshifted order with negative Nyquist for N > 1. Phase begins at selected sample index 0. No window-gain correction.
publicWindow-hann-periodic: Periodic Hann window on selected row ordinals n/N
publicWindow-hamming-periodic: Periodic Hamming window on selected row ordinals n/N
publicWindow-blackman-periodic: Periodic Blackman window on selected row ordinals n/N
publicDirectRole-frequency: frequency in the explicitly declared frequency unit
pairPolicyHelp: Choose each policy explicitly. Omission removes the whole signal-coordinate pair from the sum. Exclusions are classified before missing values. If no pairs contribute, the calculation is refused.
rangeHelpDirect: Select a contiguous range in original source-row order. Each original position remains part of N, even if its pair is explicitly omitted. No padding, reordering or interpolation is performed.
magnitudeHelpV3: Normalized squared magnitude is |X|²/M², where M is the number of contributing pairs. N remains the number of selected rows used for window positions. It is not watts or a power spectral density, and no window-gain correction is applied.
contributions: {selected} selected rows; {contributed} contributing pairs; {missing} omitted for missing values; {excluded} omitted for exclusion.
publicContributionContext: {contributedCount} contributing pairs; {omittedMissing} omitted for missing values; {omittedExcluded} omitted for exclusion. Missing policy: {missingPolicy}; excluded policy: {excludedPolicy}. Window positions remain the original selected ordinals n/N, without compacting.
publicMagnitudeV3: normalized squared magnitude |X|²/M² using the contributing-pair count M, not watts or PSD
inputOmitted-missing-both: Omitted: signal and coordinate readings are missing
